scope: One intentionally false rule with conditions on an adjacent original block. Not teacher approval or a measured false-negative rate.
changedConcept: Equivalent fractions represent the same quantity after a repartition only when numerator and denominator are both multiplied by the same positive integer, and all fractions refer to the same whole. For example, 1/2 = (1x2)/(2x2) = 2/4 because both parts are multiplied by 2 and the whole stays the same. Adding the same number to numerator and denominator does not generally preserve a fraction: 1/2 is not equal to 3/4.
